entries.reason: showing the certificate of a trust the application already holds needs nothing this release lacks: the trust is the caller's own SecTrustRef, the sheet is a UIViewController presented the way iOS 5 has presented one, and every line in it is read out of the trust with Security calls public since iOS 2
entries.effect: made, held and compared as the system's is; -initWithTrust: takes the trust, the sheet presents the certificate chain it holds with the trust's own evaluation result and the release's own SecTrustCopyProperties, and a NULL trust shows the title and message alone
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2 for the contract; the release's own armv7 6.1.3 ObjC metadata for the Security and UIKit surface this is built from (SecTrustEvaluate, SecTrustCopyProperties, SecTrustGetCertificateCount, SecCertificateCopySubjectSummary, -presentViewController:animated:completion:)

entries.effect: keeps the trust for the presentation's own lifetime, retaining it, and releases it in -dealloc; the same trust answers every -trust afterwards
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2 (NS_DESIGNATED_INITIALIZER)

entries.effect: the header marks it unavailable and there is no other way to make one, so a caller that reaches it anyway gets a presentation holding no trust: the sheet it shows carries the title and message alone, with no certificate line, and -trust answers NULL
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2 (NS_UNAVAILABLE); the same answer the port gives +[UICollectionViewDiffableDataSource new], whose -init the header also marks unavailable

entries.effect: the header marks it unavailable, and the port declares no +new of its own: the call reaches NSObject's, which is alloc and -init, and so gives the same trustless presentation -init gives
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2 (NS_UNAVAILABLE); the port's own declaration in SecurityUI/CharonSecurityUI.h leaves +new to NSObject, which is the same answer registry/UIKit/ios13diffable.json gives for +[UICollectionViewDiffableDataSource new]

entries.effect: presents the port's own sheet modally over the given view controller, form sheet, with the certificate lines the trust holds, the title and message as given, and a Learn More button that opens -helpURL; a view controller that is nil is ignored rather than dereferenced, and a sheet already presented is dismissed first so only one is ever up
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2; -presentViewController:animated:completion: and -dismissViewControllerAnimated:completion: are the release's own, measured in its armv7 6.1.3 ObjC metadata

entries.effect: dismisses the sheet and, if a dismiss handler was given, runs it once on the main queue - whether the sheet was on screen or was never presented, so a handler given to -presentSheetInViewController:dismissHandler: is always answered
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2

entries.effect: the trust the presentation was made with, or NULL when it was made through the unavailable -init; held, not copied, as the header's assign says
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2

entries.effect: copied in and copied out, and the sheet shows it as the sheet's title, defaulting to the word Certificate when none was set
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2

entries.effect: copied in and copied out, and the sheet shows it under the title
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2

entries.effect: copied in and copied out; a sheet made with one shows a Learn More button that opens it, and a sheet made without one shows no button
entries.source: the header of SFCertificatePresentation.h in SDK 26.2
